BiblicalUsage: Job gives this word to the proud beast, the fierce lion that has not trodden the path to wisdom's mine. It appears again with Leviathan, who is a king over all the children of pride.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe pride makes a man a beast in God's sight, and Leviathan rules only over those who share his pride.
